newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet opens up, Telecom Italia down.
newsitem.headline: Stet opens up, Telecom Italia down.

text.p: Italian state telecommunications holding Stet opened 4.42 percent higher at 5925 lire per share on the Milan bourse following news it will be merged with Telecom Italia.
But state controlled Telecom Italia fell 2.7 percent at the start to 3230 lire per share.
The Treasury announced yesterday the two companies would merge as part of an effort to meet an agreement with the European Commission on reducing the debts of state industrial holding Iri.
Privatisation of Italy's telecoms companies will be delayed until late in 1997. Stet had been due to be privatised by March next year.
